title: Invertibility of one evaluated finite purity word
statement: Fix a finite field datum $D$ of characteristic $p$, a prime $\ell\ne p$, a finite extension $E/\mathbf Q_\ell$, and Noetherian separated finite-type schemes $X,Y$ over the fixed algebraic closure. Let $f:X\to Y$ be smooth of relative dimension $d\ge0$, with a factorization $X\xrightarrow{j}Z\xrightarrow{p}Y$ in which $j$ is an open immersion and $p$ is proper. Use the strict coefficient towers, their uniform constructible finite-Tor categories, and fixed adjunction/evaluation presentations [det-sp-tower-gluing, sk-def-sp-normalized-towers]. At positive level $n+1$, for any diagonal/DNC-normalized finite orientation $\alpha$ and any uniform constructible finite-Tor input tower $K$, the image under normalized site realization of finite ordinary $\gamma(K_n)$, followed by the inverse unique right-adjoint comparison, is invertible [def-sp-tower-gamma-data]. This is a single finite map, not a tower purity assertion.

source.place: (2), invertibility of finite gamma at one positive level

proof.text:
the positive exponent is invertible on Y because ell differs from the
field characteristic. Its image is invertible in every stalk. Apply the library's
smooth_tensor_duality to the same finite quotient and smooth morphism; its tensor
map is exactly the second factor in finite gamma. The first factor is tensor of
alpha inverse, so is invertible for any supplied alpha. The unique right-adjoint
comparison and the site realization also preserve inverses. No input normalization
or ramification restriction is used. The n=0 exponent is ell > 0, and d=0 is included.
